about_the_game:
Welcome to the chaos of civilisation.
Race wars, political coups, and full-blown riots, it’s all part of the simulation. Citizens aren’t just peaceful little people anymore. They can protest, become radical, or turn your city into ashes overnight. Will you rule with mercy or crush anyone against you?

Power-hungry politicians will fight for control.
They’ll demand new laws, more freedom, or worse, total dominance. Will you bend to their will, or erase them from existence so they never rise again?

Implement laws, taxes, and policies.
You are their leader. Their president. Their god. Keep them happy or face mass unrest. Angry mobs will come for your throne if you ignore their cries.

The Bobbies

Every citizen race is bobbies, they call themself bobbies and you will too. Every little citizen will have their own feelings, and act based on those feelings. they will also learn by making choices, either bad or guilty.

But beware.
If the Bobbies ever realise it’s a simulation… things might get weird. They’ll question everything, including you. Will you guide them with kindness, or show them who’s really in control?

The danger around the corner.

If a pandemic breaks out… everything can spiral. Fear spreads faster than the virus. Citizens will panic, isolate, rebel, or blame you. Will you cure the disease and restore order, or let nature take its course and watch who survives?

Key Features:

▪ God Simulator – Rule with unlimited power. No mana, no cooldowns, only consequences.

▪ Deep Society Simulation – Citizens have emotions, needs, and beliefs. One upset Bobby can trigger a revolution.

▪ Dynamic Politics – Watch kingdoms rise and fall. Support a side or let the world burn.

▪ Racial Conflict – Prejudice and hate can divide your world, or you can fight it with unity and hope.

▪ Trade & Enchantment – Collect, sell, and enchant Bobbies. Each one brings something new to your society.

▪ Build & Shape – Design cities, terraform land, craft wonders, or unleash destruction.

▪ Absolute Chaos – Riots, plagues, meteor showers, tornadoes, nukes, dragons, and even… Crabzilla.

▪ Simulation Twist – Will your Bobbies uncover the truth? If they do, prepare for the unexpected.

Create your own civilisation.
Or destroy it in the most ridiculous way possible.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core (e.g. Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 compatible GPU with at least 4 GB VRAM (e.g. NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: 6- or 8-core (e.g. Intel Core i7 / AMD Ryzen 7 or 9)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Modern GPU with at least 8 GB VRAM (e.g. NVIDIA RTX 2070/3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT)
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: Can you manage a civilisation with taxes, political wars, race wars and pandemics?
